api.callers.description: Number of pages citing an operation, in the operations table of the API page.

api.colCallers.description: Header of the callers column of the operations table of the API page.

api.colMethod.description: Header of the method column of the operations table of the API page.

api.colOperation.description: Header of the operation column of the operations table of the API page.

api.colPath.description: Header of the path column of the operations table of the API page.

api.contract.description: Heading of the block of the API page that shows the imported contract.

api.download.description: Link to the original contract file on the API page.

api.fiveKeys.defaultMessage: Five keys, no more. The operations come from the contract, not from the header.
api.fiveKeys.description: Note under the properties of the API page, cut to five keys.

api.gapsLead.defaultMessage: The rows in italics are gaps: present in the contract without a page, or described without existing in the contract.
api.gapsLead.description: Sentence after the lead of the operations table when the contract and the notes disagree.

api.imported.description: When the contract was imported, relative to the build, on the line of the contract block of the API page.

api.noOperation.description: Notice of the operations table of the API page when the contract declares none.

api.notInContract.description: Gap row of the operations table for a note the contract does not declare.

api.operations.description: Heading of the operations table of the API page.

api.operationsFirst.defaultMessage: On an interface the operations rise to the top: that is the grain we work at.
api.operationsFirst.description: Note under the related pages of the API page, where the operations come first.

api.operationsLead.defaultMessage: Matched to the contract by operation name.
api.operationsLead.description: Sentence under the heading of the operations table of the API page.

api.unknownPath.description: Path cell of a gap row of the operations table when the note declares none.

api.viewerNote.defaultMessage: No schema is copied into the text: the page shows the contract, it does not duplicate it.
api.viewerNote.description: Note next to the contract viewer of the API page.

api.withoutPage.defaultMessage: present in the contract, without a page
api.withoutPage.description: Gap row of the operations table for an operation no note describes.
